connector.name: FirstData
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP server for finding authoritative primary data sources and official portals.
connector.summary: Hosted at firstdata.deepminer.com.cn over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vist233 account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using FIRSTDATA_API_KEY. Apply for human or agent access at https://firstdata.deepminer.com.cn/#apply
